page.overview:
What is Fletchling?

Fletchling is a small bird-like Pokémon. It has a bright orange head and a mostly pale purplish-gray body. The tips of its grayish wings are white, and it has a small black and white striped tail. It has round black eyes, a small black beak, and tiny black feet and talons.

Fletchling is highly docile and fond to people, especially trainers. They emit beautiful chirps to listeners and bird-watchers. In battle, Fletchling is volatile, being hasty, swift and relentless. Fletchling is also shown to have great determination, as one hardly shows any signs of "chickening-out" from battles.

Although mostly amicable, Fletching in the wild are still rather territorial. In fact, they will mercilessly attack anyone that they deem as intruders that enter their territories by ignoring their melodious warning cries.

A Fletchling is known for its constantly warm body, which is helpful for Trainers living in cold areas to stay warm. However, a person must never touch this Pokémon unexpectedly, as doing so will result in them getting burned from the excited or startled Fletchling.
